definitions: The act or process of lifting or elevating something.
The act of bringing up or caring for a child or young animal.
The act of collecting or accumulating money or funds.
The act of constructing or erecting a building or structure.
An increase in amount, level, or intensity.
examples: The raising of the flag was a solemn moment.
She dedicated her life to the raising of her children.
The charity is focused on the raising of funds for medical research.
The raising of the new skyscraper transformed the city skyline.
There was a significant raising of awareness about environmental issues.
